name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Project workflows, source evidence and lane-specific tools over a persistent engine.

interface.shortDescription: Project work with persistent state, source evidence and scoped tools.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane connects Codex to a persistent project engine and visible read-only Studio. Each authority and sector lane owns its separate SQLite database and files; the project evidence head coordinator binds their current heads. Distinct first-class skills route project workflows through the typed engine, lane contracts and selected tools.
defaultPrompt: Open my Evidence Lane project and show its current work and evidence.
Query my selected project sources with attribution.
Refresh my project and continue the next eligible task.
